title: A Typewriter for the Uniform
author: S. M. Marchetti
blurb: Oscar Thornbury, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent ten years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
